hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line1.about: the Vein-Mason reminding the player that the scar pattern is not yet flesh, and telling them to carve it cell by cell at the Cerebral Scarring Station

hemomancy.anchorite.carve_reminder.line2.about: the Vein-Mason walking through carving: load the pattern, trace the purple stencil in red, carve (a rejected carving keeps work), then place the Scar in an empty lit Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection for 50 mL, and hold Blood Absorption to learn it for 100 mL, noting the old template alone will not teach it

hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line1.about: the Vein-Mason's short verdict that the player's wound has become architecture, marking the scar lesson as complete

hemomancy.anchorite.completed.line2.about: the Vein-Mason saying more patterns will now answer the player, and warning them to weigh each cut by what it opens and closes in the body

hemomancy.anchorite.continuation_reward..about: the Vein-Mason saying the first wound answered another, and inviting the player to take the next pattern when ready to choose for themselves

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.activation.about: the Vein-Mason explaining how to run a Thelemic dose: distill and drink it, equip and select its memory, press the manipulation-use key to enable it (spending blood and reserve), and crouch with the key to arm an overexertion response costing twice the blood and two-and-a-half times the strain

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.cause_strain.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to use a Thelemic Memory until one body section becomes Varicose, and that only the body's own instruction counts, not steel or projected will

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.complete.about: the Vein-Mason noting the vessel has been injured, repaired and prepared, and offering the deeper pattern

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.diagnosis.prompt.about: the Vein-Mason offering to read the player's vessel before treatment, saying that once the injury is named the medicine will be clear

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.fortify.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that medicine restores what was spent, and that the fourth-Degree rite Hematic Fortification permanently cuts vascular strain by 15 percent, after which the player should return with earned diagnosis and treatment kept

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.recover.about: the Vein-Mason matching treatments to damage: the Alchemist's Salve for one failing course, the Poultice across two, and Vascular Mending for clotting or widespread Varicosity

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.return_diagnosis.about: the Vein-Mason offering to read where the player's current catches, so the damage rather than habit chooses the medicine

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.reward.prompt.about: the Vein-Mason saying the player has borne injury, treatment and preparation, and trusting them with the deeper pattern

hemomancy.anchorite.d5.stop.about: the Vein-Mason giving training safety rules: watch the named body section in Vascular Status, stop when it first becomes Varicose below 50 health, press the use key again without crouching to disable the memory, bring Salve, return for diagnosis before treatment, and know that earned progress stays

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.change_loadout.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to prepare a different arrangement at the Mason's Effigy and burn it, so the active scar set changes

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.complete.about: the Vein-Mason saying the current changed because the player changed its banks, and that the final pattern is ready

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.first_route.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to keep a cerebral scar aligned with a Noetic Memory's primary temper and cast that memory, noting mechanical projections do not count

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that a scar can route an instruction, that writing it is a Mnemonist's work, and asking the player to carry the question to one

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral.prompt.about: the Vein-Mason handing the question about routing to the Mnemonist, telling the player to take the referral, hear their counsel, then return to prove the route

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.reward.prompt.about: the Vein-Mason saying the player changed the route and it bore another instruction, so the final pattern is theirs

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.second_route.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to make the changed architecture bear another matching Noetic Memory

hemomancy.anchorite.d6.seek_counsel.about: the Vein-Mason sending the player back to the Mnemonist first, since the Mnemonist reads what the memory means and the Vein-Mason decides how the body carries it

hemomancy.anchorite.effigy_instruction.l.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that the scar is known and the Mason's Effigy arranges scars the blood already remembers, and that whoever charges a motif must know all its scars and have room for them

the Vein-Mason detailing Effigy use: craft Runic Motif Paper from Paper, Charcoal and Sanguine Formation, choose a known scar and press Prepare, place the paper and project 500 mL per scar, selection stays fixed, charging can stop and resume, breaking returns paper not blood, and only the Brazier commits the Pattern

hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.given.l.about: the Vein-Mason saying the pattern lays a route and power moves only when a scar carries it

the Vein-Mason ordering the first lesson steps: carve the Scar item, burn it, only then may the Effigy prepare a living motif, with a nearby Scarring Station allowed under watch for the first scar and the player's own built station required afterward

hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line1.about: the Vein-Mason introducing themself as the Vein-Mason who teaches vessels where to remember breaking and then mends them around that memory

hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line2.about: the Vein-Mason saying the player's strongest temper has chosen the first cut, and telling them to take its old Scar Pattern and carve it at the Cerebral Scarring Station

hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.line3.about: the Vein-Mason listing carving ingredients (blank plate, catalyst, knapper, pattern) and noting an empty lit Iron Brazier decides afterward whether the scar becomes memory

hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.prompt.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player that their strongest temper sets the first cut, and to accept the pattern and carve it at the Scarring Station

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_memory.about: the Vein-Mason on a blank memory vessel, saying the Mnemonist gives it meaning while the Vein-Mason cares where that meaning travels through the player
the Vein-Mason saying the Mnemonist's craft is instruction and theirs is tissue, and the two must agree

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_scar.l.about: the Vein-Mason identifying a Blank Scar as tissue prepared to receive an authored pattern
the Vein-Mason contrasting the Artificer, who reinforces what faces the world, with themself, who reinforces what must carry the current within

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.brazier.line.about: the Vein-Mason saying the Iron Brazier either teaches a carved scar or commits an Effigy pattern

the Vein-Mason detailing Brazier use: place one offering with ordinary use, Blood Projection lights it for 50 mL, hold Blood Absorption until it dissolves, a carved Scar costs 100 mL to learn, a prepared Pattern 50 mL to commit, and sneaking retrieves the offering unburned

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.conductive_m.about: the Vein-Mason describing Conductive Mark as Noetic, a projected instruction led by its primary temper
the Vein-Mason explaining that an aligned active cerebral scar lets the memory's vascular route bear less strain

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line1.about: the Vein-Mason saying the Effigy prepares a set from scars already burned into memory

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line2.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to burn the prepared motif at an Iron Brazier to make that set active

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line1.about: the Vein-Mason saying the vascular gauge reports the vessel's state while the repair is the player's work, and to read the number beside the flow state

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line2.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that hovering a gauge section shows which Noetic and Thelemic routes burden it

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.pattern.line.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that a Scar Pattern carries instruction, to be carved at the station, with learned scars arranged at the Effigy
the Vein-Mason noting that tier-three instruction still requires Deep Inscription

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.poultice.lin.about: the Vein-Mason saying the Poultice distributes repair across the two weakest body sections
the Vein-Mason warning that once clotting begins the player should stop improvising and perform Vascular Mending

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line1.about: the Vein-Mason saying the Alchemist's Salve closes one local failure and is field medicine, not conditioning

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line2.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to use the Salve when one body section falls below Stable

hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.tier_one.lin.about: the Vein-Mason explaining that a first-tier pattern deepens one temper while active and can route a matching Noetic Memory
the Vein-Mason explaining that routing through a first pattern eases strain by five percent, matching scars share one route, and only the strongest route applies

hemomancy.anchorite.item_hint.about: the Vein-Mason inviting the player to set an item before them so they can say what it asks of the vessel

hemomancy.anchorite.loadout_reminder.lin.about: the Vein-Mason reminding the player the Effigy has written the motif and that the Brazier now decides whether the arrangement can live in them

the Vein-Mason directing the player to place the prepared Scar Pattern in an empty lit Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection for 50 mL, hold Blood Absorption, and noting that committing costs 50 mL, changes the active cerebral loadout, and needs no relearning of the scar

hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line1.about: the Vein-Mason refusing to teach scars yet because the player's vessel is not prepared

hemomancy.anchorite.locked.line2.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to return at the fourth Degree with active blood, since the mind must survive a sympathetic wound

hemomancy.anchorite.opinion.artificer.li.about: the Vein-Mason saying the Artificer shores up what meets the world: plate, weapon, frame and graft
the Vein-Mason saying they work inward, where scar and vessel decide whether an instruction survives its passage

hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line1.about: the Vein-Mason refusing the player because still-water has touched them and a scar cut into that body would fight itself cruelly

hemomancy.anchorite.refusal.line2.about: the Vein-Mason telling the player to leave scar-work to those who still bargain with blood-memory

hemomancy.anchorite.replace_pattern.prom.about: the Vein-Mason offering to replace the last pattern they gave, but only if the player lost it

hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line1.about: the Vein-Mason saying the next pattern is the player's, to be carved only when the body can afford another instruction

hemomancy.anchorite.reward.claimed.line2.about: the Vein-Mason noting Motif Paper revises a scar loadout, which reads like a sentence, and urging the player to place its pauses with care

hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line1.about: the Vein-Mason noting the player made the first wound answer another, and calling that enough for now

hemomancy.anchorite.reward.line2.about: the Vein-Mason handing over a second old pattern, observing the player's blood shouted the first, and telling them to listen to the voice beneath it and practice choosing

hemomancy.artificer.armature.line1.about: the Artificer saying the Armature is no anvil but works the piece the player is wearing while they hold still

hemomancy.artificer.armature.line2.about: the Artificer listing Armature steps as short orders: wear the armor, load the bowls with reagent, fill the reservoir, step into the frame, hold still

hemomancy.artificer.armature.line3.about: the Artificer stating the Armature works worn pieces in order helm, chest, legs, boots, and that finished pieces keep their change if it stops partway

hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line1.about: the Artificer telling the player that Armature access begins at the second Degree and until then they only watch the rack

hemomancy.artificer.armature_hint.line2.about: the Artificer saying Armature work first needs stable blood and proper iron, and to bring both when the player gets there

hemomancy.artificer.assignment.assumed_l.about: an assignment objective telling the player to transform the Living Staff into a weapon form and defeat a hostile with it
an assignment objective telling the player to complete one Living Weapon Graft rite
the Artificer telling the player to learn all seven base Living Weapon forms first before the final fitting

hemomancy.artificer.assignment.crimson_v.about: an assignment objective telling the player to complete the Rite of Armature Consecration
an assignment objective telling the player to take the Artificer's inspection to an Alchemist, who will give them Crimson Lacquer
an assignment objective telling the player to land a direct hit so the full vestment draws or banks blood
an assignment objective telling the player to complete the first Blood Lust upgrade
an assignment objective telling the player to complete the full Blood Lust set and wear it

hemomancy.artificer.assignment.three_ans.about: the Artificer telling the player to take their record of the chosen armor answer to an Alchemist, who will match its reagent and point out useful Bestiary specimens
an assignment objective telling the player to prove the armor set answers in the field through retaliation, projectile reduction or prismatic flash
the Artificer telling the player to make their first Barbed, Chitinite or Prismatic armor piece, and that the first family they make is the answer recorded
an assignment objective telling the player to complete the full set of their recorded armor family and wear it

hemomancy.artificer.assignment.weight_of.about: an assignment objective telling the player to complete the Rite of the Monolithic Armature
an assignment objective telling the player to activate their lineage's own armor ability
the Artificer telling the player to complete their first seventh-Degree armor upgrade, whose lineage will be recorded permanently
an assignment objective telling the player to complete the full set of their recorded seventh-Degree lineage and wear it

hemomancy.artificer.assignment.worn_vow..about: an assignment objective telling the player to use the Armature and complete one Hematic Iron upgrade
an assignment objective telling the player to complete the full Hematic Iron set and wear it before asking for the final fitting
an assignment objective telling the player to place a Hematic Armature in their own workshop and then return

hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line1.about: the Artificer approving that the player has done staff fittings, saying a fitting means they have worn the work long enough that it answers back

hemomancy.artificer.assignments.line2.about: the Artificer demanding to know where the armor is, and insisting it must be worn on the player, since armor in a pack does not count for a worn vow

hemomancy.artificer.d7_lineage.edacious.about: a short label naming the Edacious lineage

hemomancy.artificer.d7_lineage.none.about: a short label meaning no seventh-Degree lineage has been recorded yet

hemomancy.artificer.d7_lineage.phantasma.about: a short label naming the Phantasmal lineage

hemomancy.artificer.d7_lineage.sheolic.about: a short label naming the Sheolic lineage

hemomancy.artificer.d7_lineage.silent_ar.about: a short label naming the Silent Archon lineage

hemomancy.artificer.fork_family.barbed.about: a short label naming the Barbed armor family

hemomancy.artificer.fork_family.chitinit.about: a short label naming the Chitinite armor family

hemomancy.artificer.fork_family.none.about: a short label meaning no armor family has been chosen yet

hemomancy.artificer.fork_family.prismati.about: a short label naming the Prismatic armor family

hemomancy.artificer.forks.line1.about: the Artificer summarizing the three armor forks: Barbed sends insults back, Chitinite endures them, and Prismatic makes the strike lose its way

hemomancy.artificer.forks.line2.about: the Artificer asking what the player expects to fight and telling them to choose by danger, since color has nothing to do with it

hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line1.about: the Artificer warning that the player's Living Staff has the appetite of a living inheritance, so it must not be treated like a wand, noting memories train the player while grafts train the staff

hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line2.about: the Artificer instructing the player to act like the form first, craft the graft, light the Brazier with Blood Projection, and draw the shape in with Blood Absorption

hemomancy.artificer.grafts.line3.about: the Artificer clarifying that Somatic Loom work stays at the Loom while living limbs return to the staff through the brazier

hemomancy.artificer.identity.line1.about: the Artificer introducing themself as the Redwright, Artificer of the Living Vow

hemomancy.artificer.identity.line2.about: the Artificer distinguishing their work: the Alchemist refines blood, the Mnemonist teaches memory, and they teach the body's tools to take a blood-vow

hemomancy.artificer.identity.line3.about: the Artificer saying armor is a vow worn under pressure and a staff-form is a limb not yet disciplined

hemomancy.artificer.item_hint.about: the Artificer asking what the player is carrying and telling them to set it out so they can say which pieces belong to the frame

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.aculeat.about: the Artificer identifying Aculeate Vitriol as Barbed work that teaches Hematic Iron to answer harm with thorn, venom and spite
the Artificer asking whether the player wants armor that remembers who hurt it and hits back, and telling them to put the vitriol in the Armature

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.chromat.about: the Artificer identifying Chromatic Sublimate as Prismatic work: flash, misdirection, spectacle and angles that leave a strike unsure where it lands
the Artificer saying Prismatic armor is taught to lie while it takes hits, lies well, and should not be mistaken for decoration

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.crimson.about: the Artificer identifying Crimson Lacquer as a Lodge-grade coat for armor that has already picked its fork
the Artificer explaining that the frame must be consecrated first, then the lacquer carries Barbed, Chitinite or Prismatic work up into Blood Lust

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.grinnin.about: the Artificer identifying the Grinning Mask as meant for Blood Lust built on Prismatic work
the Artificer saying to fit the mask there, and that a clean hit gets the wearer moving before the reply comes

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.hematic.about: the Artificer describing the Hematic Armature as a ritual frame that changes armor while it is worn, and insisting it is not a forge
the Artificer listing Armature use: feed its bowls, fill its blood reservoir, wear the piece to be changed, stand in the rack, and if the bargain holds the metal learns
the Artificer saying Hematic Iron Scrap is metal that has started listening but is not armor until it learns to obey
the Artificer telling the player to wear iron and feed the scrap to the Armature, so the first iron piece can take the Hematic shape

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_ar.about: the Artificer dismissing plain iron armor as honest and dull, never having met the player's blood
the Artificer offering the first lesson: wear the iron armor into the Armature along with Hematic Iron Scrap

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.iron_br.about: the Artificer saying the Iron Brazier burns rite-fire and uses up whatever is fed to it as instruction

the Artificer instructing: set a Living Weapon Graft in the Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, hold the Living Staff and draw with Blood Absorption, so the flame hands the limb over rather than eating it

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.living_.about: the Artificer saying a Living Staff is hungry for shape and has no interest in memory
the Artificer explaining the graft rite teaches the staff to answer with the ordinary living weapon manipulations while the player still picks the form through the usual loadout and radial
the Artificer describing a Living Weapon Graft as a prepared limb-pattern earned by behaving like the form it carries

the Artificer instructing: set the graft in the Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, draw through a Living Staff, and if the blood has earned the shape the player gets that form's conjure lesson

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.lodesto.about: the Artificer identifying the Lodestone Faceplate as meant for Blood Lust built on Chitinite shelter
the Artificer saying to fit the faceplate there, and that a clean hit gives a brief second skin

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.memory_.about: the Artificer recognizing the Memory of Vesper as a staff-bearing inheritance, and saying the sermon in it is not their business
the Artificer explaining the Memory no longer answers a bare hand: set it in an Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, and draw the refusal out through a Living Staff

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.monolit.about: the Artificer saying the Monolithic Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember a weight ordinary blood should not carry, with the extra strength a side effect
the Artificer explaining the Cornerstone is offered at a Cardinal rite beside a consecrated Armature, after which the frame can carry the final Blood Lust forms and Silent Archon work

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.refusal.about: the Artificer ending the conversation because the player's blood has refused the Artificer's frame, though they know the item

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.sclerot.about: the Artificer identifying Sclerotic Oleum as Chitinite work: shell, endurance and ferric shelter
the Artificer saying to use the oleum for armor that holds the line, though it will not answer every bite

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.tengu_m.about: the Artificer identifying the Tengu Mask as meant for Blood Lust built on Barbed spite
the Artificer saying to fit the mask there, and that every clean hit keeps the target bleeding after the blade is gone

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.velorum.about: the Artificer describing the Velorum Mask as heavy iron that never warms and keeps a still, silent witness
the Artificer saying Saint-metal does not care which path the player's Blood Lust took, and that a clean hit lets its witness give a little blood back

hemomancy.artificer.item_inquiry.vicars_.about: the Artificer explaining they made the Armature Consecration Kit for the base rack, the Vicar teaches the rite, and the kit readies the frame for it
the Artificer explaining the kit is offered during the Rite of Armature Consecration, and that afterward the frame can witness Lodge-grade Blood Lust work where before it only did craft

hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.given.about: the Artificer telling the player to take the kit to a Greater Cardinal Focus for the rite, and to keep the frame clear until both blood circuits close

hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line1.about: the Artificer announcing they will issue one Armature Consecration Kit, to be taken to a Greater Cardinal Focus on a Greater Working floor with a base Armature and the Living Staff

hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line2.about: the Artificer explaining the rite readies the frame for Blood Lust armor, that an interrupted rite returns the offering, and that no second free kit can be given

hemomancy.artificer.late_armature.line3.about: the Artificer explaining how to craft another kit from two Hematic Iron Scraps around Ferric Binder, a Blood Crystal Shard and a Sanguine Formation, and offering to show the pattern

hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.constru.about: the Artificer teaching Living Staff construction: lay a line of iron bars with Venous Stone at both ends, hold a Sanguine Formation, project 150 mL of blood into the bars, noting a Neophyte can already form it and should learn it before the Vicar has them plant it for a rite

hemomancy.artificer.living_staff.use.about: the Artificer explaining Living Staff use: the bond is earned once formed, select Conjure Staff to recall it to an empty hand, select Blood Absorption or Blood Projection and hold the Staff to channel it, use it on a Cardinal Focus to start a matching rite, and an early staff will not raise Degree or let inactive blood answer a rite

hemomancy.artificer.monolithic_armature..about: the Artificer saying the Cornerstone teaches the frame to remember a weight ordinary blood should not carry, with the extra strength a side effect
the Artificer explaining where Blood Lust branches by lineage: Proboscis for Edacious, Fervent Husk for Sheolic, Ambergris for Phantasmal, and Silent Archon cloth being its own vow

hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line1.about: the Artificer telling a Neophyte they have earned a spot by the rack, though the spot belongs to the work and not to them

hemomancy.artificer.neophyte.line2.about: the Artificer saying Armature work waits until the player has stable blood and proper iron

hemomancy.artificer.refusal.line1.about: the Artificer refusing the player because they have set their blood against the Artificer's tools, and iron is not fitted to blood that refuses it

hemomancy.artificer.refusal.line2.about: the Artificer dismissing the player, telling them to take their stillness elsewhere

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.early.about: the Artificer telling a third-Degree player they can build the Resonant Forge on a Working floor from an anvil, cauldron, grindstone and two Hematic Iron blocks, plus Ferric Binder, 500 mL of blood and a blank Wax Cylinder, that it is not needed yet, and that a full transfer lesson comes at the fourth Degree

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.lesso.about: the Artificer teaching the forge's grinding side: set enchanted equipment and a blank Wax Cylinder there, keep blood in the basin, start the wheel, and it cuts the pattern out into cleaned equipment and an engraved cylinder

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste.about: the Artificer explaining the master cam can stabilize an engraved Ambergris Cylinder for 1,000 mL, after which it survives every proper application, and that ordinary wax cannot hold a master pattern
the Artificer saying the player's precision forge is ready for its last mechanism and offering the Master Cam Kit along with the rite that seats it

the Artificer handing over the Master Cam Kit and explaining the Rite of the Enduring Pattern: set the kit with five more offerings on lit braziers, three points of reader, hammer and stabilizer, each given 250 mL in order

the Artificer stating Master Cam requirements: learn grinding and application, grind a single chosen vibration from a tool at a Precision Forge personally, be seventh Degree with blood awake, and an unclaimed earlier gift does not matter
a dialogue option title for asking the Artificer about a lasting pattern

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.pract.about: the Artificer telling a sixth-Degree player to practice moving a Scriptorium curse or a chosen enchantment, explaining the base wheel moves the whole pattern while a Precision governor picks one part, on the same forge with no new tier

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci.about: the Artificer saying the governor is the player's and the Rite of the True Groove changes the forge they already have, keeping its blood, tools and wear
the Artificer saying the player knows the base forge and has reached the fifth Degree, so they can be given the Precision Governor Kit for the next rite

the Artificer handing over the Precision Governor Kit and explaining the rite: seat the forge behind a Cardinal Focus, set the kit with five more offerings on lit braziers, close two marked grooves with 250 mL each, then the wheel can choose one enchantment or the curse beneath
the Artificer stating that the player must grind one pattern into wax and hammer one pattern back into a tool, then at the fifth Degree gets a governor able to separate one vibration from the rest
a dialogue option title for asking the Artificer about a finer groove

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.promp.about: the Artificer explaining the forge copies an enchantment's cadence into ambergris wax and hammers it into another tool, and offering to put the pattern in the player's notes if they are building one

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.taugh.about: the Artificer teaching application: move the engraved cylinder beside target equipment on the hammer side, start application, compatible enchantments carry over, an ordinary cylinder is used up, Ambergris also works for ordinary patterns, and the hammer and wheel need tending when they wear

hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.title.about: a dialogue option title for asking the Artificer about the Resonant Forge

hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line1.about: the Artificer saying a fitting in a pocket is only an appointment, and telling the player to raise the Scarlet Vanity on a Working floor at Degree 3 to wear it on the staff

hemomancy.artificer.scarlet_vanity.line2.about: the Artificer noting the same bench holds the player's charm, blood gourd and Morphling Jar, four slots on one bench

hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line1.about: the Artificer turning away a player whose blood has not awakened, warning their tools would just bruise them

hemomancy.artificer.unawakened.line2.about: the Artificer telling the player to come back once their blood is awake, so the iron has a reason to listen

hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line1.about: the Artificer saying the rack is listening and the player should talk to it with armor, reagent and blood

hemomancy.artificer.workshop.line2.about: the Artificer telling the player to ask cleanly, because a cluttered lesson makes bad metal

hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.lesson.about: the Alchemist teaching the Phlebotomist's Cabinet after three examined sources: keep provenance in order, nine pigeonholes each hold 64 component-identical full vials, click a vial in or click empty-handed to withdraw one, fit a glass pane to see inside, sneak-use a Knapper to remove it, then craft one and store and withdraw a sample

hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.prompt.about: the Alchemist saying three distinct sources are enough to begin a proper collection and offering to teach the Phlebotomist's Cabinet

hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.title.about: a short title for the Phlebotomist's Cabinet lesson

hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.lesso.about: the Mnemonist teaching the Clairaudiograph once the Alchemist has identified the specimen: put a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank cylinder in, select a call, Carve for four seconds, the blood is used up and the empty vial kept, Preview plays only for the player while Play reaches nearby listeners, and a carved cylinder holds an expression with no injectable property

hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.promp.about: the Mnemonist saying the Alchemist has named the specimen and offering to teach the player to carve what its blood remembers saying

hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.title.about: a short title for the Clairaudiograph lesson about carving a creature's remembered calls

hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.lesson.about: the Alchemist saying they can identify the blood and its properties but the residual auditory pattern is outside their field, so the player should go to the Mnemonist, with questions allowed at Degree 2 and formal recording instruction starting at Degree 3

hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.prompt.about: the Alchemist saying the player's samples carry something physiology cannot explain, and offering to refer the residue to the Mnemonist

hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.title.about: a short title for the lesson referring unexplained sample residue to the Mnemonist

hemomancy.clinical.field_case.lesson.about: the Artificer teaching the Field Case after the Alchemist's referral: rebuild an empty Cabinet with leather and Hematic Iron Scraps (consuming the Cabinet), place the case before opening it, nine cells hold sixteen matching vials each, to pick it up close menus, wait for the lid and sneak-use it empty-handed, and carried it keeps each specimen's identity and count

hemomancy.clinical.field_case.prompt.about: the Artificer confirming the Alchemist's referral is in order and offering to show how to rebuild a Cabinet for travel without losing specimens

hemomancy.clinical.field_case.title.about: a short title for the Field Case lesson about carrying a laboratory abroad

hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.lesson.about: the Alchemist saying the Cabinet suits the laboratory, not the road, and sending the player to the Artificer they have met with their storage practice and Hematic Iron to ask for a Field Case, while the Alchemist answers for specimens and the Artificer for hinges and catches

hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.prompt.about: the Alchemist noting the player's cabinet work is sound and they have met the Artificer, and offering a referral for field equipment

hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.title.about: a short title for the referral turning laboratory storage into a travelling Cabinet

hemomancy.clinical.injection.lesson.about: the Alchemist teaching injection: having seen what the specimen carries, hold Use with a filled creature Blood Vial for 0.8 seconds, the blood is used up and the vial kept, read the identified response first, benefits are temporary with possible drawbacks, Transfusion Saturation blocks another injection for twenty seconds, and the microscope does not consume the sample

hemomancy.clinical.injection.locked.about: a note telling the player to examine a sample and learn Borrowed Physiology before injecting

hemomancy.clinical.injection.prompt.about: the Alchemist saying the player has examined blood closely enough to understand the risk and offering to teach borrowing its physiology

hemomancy.clinical.injection.title.about: a short title for the Borrowed Physiology injection lesson

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alembic.about: the Alchemist explaining that at Degree 2 the Ghastly Alembic opens reagent distillation and broader temper work, contrasting microscopy that describes a specimen with distillation and centrifugation that extract useful material

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_cab.about: the Artificer saying Bloodwood holds the cells and Hematic Iron reinforces the frame, that provenance and exact specimen matching are the Alchemist's lessons, and that after the player uses the Cabinet and is referred they can discuss converting it for the field

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_mic.about: the Artificer admitting they can reproduce the microscope housing but cannot say why one bear's blood freezes in the glass while another's boils, and telling the player to ask the Alchemist

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_rec.about: the Artificer saying they understand the recording machine's frame and moving parts, while the Alchemist identifies the sample and the Mnemonist explains the voice it keeps, and telling the player to ask them before treating it as ordinary

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.blank_cylinde.about: the Mnemonist explaining a blank cylinder: make two ordinary Wax Cylinders from honeycomb, Active Befouling Ash and paper, set one beside a filled creature Blood Vial in the Clairaudiograph, select a call, carve for four seconds, and note Ambergris also works and is needed for lasting Masterwork patterns

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.carved_cylind.about: the Mnemonist explaining a carved cylinder already carries an expression: place it in the Clairaudiograph and press Play without fresh blood, it cannot be reused as blank stock, Preview is only for the player and Play reaches nearby listeners

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge.about: the Alchemist explaining the Vial Centrifuge belongs to Degree-2 work: put usable creature samples in opposing slots, start a balanced spin, recover the enzyme and report the separation, with the Ghastly Alembic as the other proof needed before Concentrated Blood

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge_up.about: the Alchemist explaining that at the fourth Degree they teach a governor after personal separation, at the sixth a fractionating rotor after a personal calibrated spin, both Cardinal upgrades of this same machine, and that gifted or crafted kits cannot replace practice

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.echo_hint.about: the Mnemonist suggesting there may be an echo in the player's samples but physiology comes first, telling them to examine three creature sources and get the Alchemist's referral, and at Degree 3 learn to retain the expression

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.empty_vial.about: the Alchemist telling the player to left-click a living creature with an empty Blood Vial to collect a specimen, noting the First Separation briefing supplies two and a filled vial should be brought back for microscopy

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.identified_vi.about: the Alchemist explaining an identified vial records tempers and properties, that after the Borrowed Physiology lesson holding Use for 0.8 seconds injects it, the tooltip shows temporary responses and drawbacks, the empty vial is kept, and Transfusion Saturation prevents immediate re-injection

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.later.about: the Alchemist saying the item belongs to a later lesson and telling the player to begin with the Degree-1 sampling and observation practice

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.sampling.about: the Alchemist explaining the Living Syringe draws creature blood into empty vials in its loaded eight-vial rack, is needed for thick-skinned creatures and NPCs that loose vials cannot draw from, and that the player should bring one filled vial before building a large collection

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unidentified_.about: the Alchemist saying the vial holds an unidentified specimen, telling the player to show a filled creature vial for the microscope lesson, with the microscope in the main hand and sample in the offhand for a two-second examination

hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unreadable_cy.about: the Mnemonist saying the cylinder's inscription cannot be read, advising keeping it as is since it is not blank wax, and suggesting its recording definition changed or went missing

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.cabinet.desc.about: a ledger description saying that after three source identifications the player learns the Cabinet recipe from the Alchemist

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.echoes.about: a short ledger section title for the clinical study of retained expressions

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.examined.about: a short ledger title for examining a specimen

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.examined.desc.about: a ledger description: microscope in main hand, vial in offhand, hold Use for two uninterrupted seconds, then return to the Alchemist

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.field_case.about: a short ledger title for the Laboratory Abroad Field Case lesson

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.field_case.des.about: a ledger description saying the player takes the Alchemist's referral to the Artificer to learn the Field Case recipe and placement rules

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.fieldwork.about: a short ledger section title for the clinical study of the laboratory abroad

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.injection.about: a short ledger title for the Borrowed Physiology lesson

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.injection.desc.about: a ledger description saying the player learns direct injection from the Alchemist after their first personal examination

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.iron.about: a short ledger title for meeting the Artificer

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.iron.desc.about: a ledger description telling the player to obtain Hematic Iron Scraps, speak to the Artificer, then return to the Alchemist

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.microscope.about: a short ledger title for learning microscopy

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.microscope.des.about: a ledger description telling the player to hold a filled creature vial while speaking to the Alchemist to learn the Hematic Microscope recipe

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.observation.about: a short ledger section title for the clinical study of collecting and observing

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.referral.about: a short ledger title for the Cabinet-for-the-road referral

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.referral.desc.about: a ledger description saying that at Degree 2 the player completes Cabinet practice and asks the Alchemist for a field-conversion referral

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.sources.about: a short ledger title for identifying three creature sources

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.sources.desc.about: a ledger description saying the player must personally examine three different entity types, duplicates count once, and trade-identified vials do not replace their own examination

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.storage.about: a short ledger title for storing and withdrawing

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.storage.desc.about: a ledger description saying the player must personally insert and withdraw a full sample through a Cabinet menu and automated transfers do not count

hemomancy.clinical.microscope.lesson.about: the Alchemist asking to see the player's filled creature vial and teaching microscopy: the recipe is added to their notes, hold the microscope in the main hand and a filled vial in the offhand, hold Use for two seconds, read tempers and properties, and return after a successful examination

hemomancy.clinical.microscope.prompt.about: the Alchemist saying the player brought a viable sample and offering to teach reading it under the Hematic Microscope and add the design to their notes

hemomancy.clinical.microscope.title.about: a short title for the Hematic Microscopy lesson

hemomancy.clinical.next.cabinet.about: the Alchemist noting the player has identified three distinct sources and telling them to ask for the Phlebotomist's Cabinet lesson and recipe

hemomancy.clinical.next.collect.about: the Alchemist directing the player to start with the First Separation assignment: sample living creatures with its loose vials, balance the Centrifuge, recover the enzyme, report back for a Living Syringe and initialized eight-vial rack, then bring one filled creature vial to discuss observation

hemomancy.clinical.next.degree_two.about: the Alchemist laying out the path after the Vicar grants Degree 2: complete First Separation and an Alembic distillation, ask for Concentrated Blood, inject it, then sleep to reach Degree 3

hemomancy.clinical.next.echo_referral.about: the Alchemist telling the player to examine three creature sources, ask about the residual echo at Degree 2, and bring that referral to the Mnemonist for formal study at Degree 3

hemomancy.clinical.next.examine.about: the Alchemist telling the player to craft the Hematic Microscope, hold it in the main hand with a single filled creature Blood Vial in the offhand, hold Use for two uninterrupted seconds, then return

hemomancy.clinical.next.field_case.about: the Alchemist telling the player to place the Field Case to open it, to pick it up close all menus, let the lid shut and sneak-use it empty-handed, and to ask what belongs in its cells

hemomancy.clinical.next.field_referral.about: the Alchemist saying the player must be referred first: at Degree 2 craft a Cabinet, personally insert and withdraw a sample, obtain Hematic Iron Scraps, meet the Artificer, then return to the Alchemist for the handoff

hemomancy.clinical.next.formal_study.about: the Mnemonist confirming the Alchemist's referral is recorded and telling the player that at Degree 3 they should ask for What Blood Remembers Saying to learn the Clairaudiograph and Wax Cylinder recipes

hemomancy.clinical.next.injection.about: the Alchemist telling the player that after examining a creature sample themself they should ask about Borrowed Physiology, which unlocks direct injection

hemomancy.clinical.next.iron_artificer.about: the Alchemist telling the player that at Degree 2 they should obtain Hematic Iron Scraps and meet the Artificer, then return after crafting, filling and withdrawing from their Cabinet

hemomancy.clinical.next.later_study.about: the Alchemist saying the Artificer handles the player's field conversion, to ask about Beyond Ordinary Analysis once three creature sources are examined, and that formal mnemonic recording is the Mnemonist's work

hemomancy.clinical.next.recording.about: the Mnemonist telling the player to use a filled creature vial and blank Wax Cylinder in the Clairaudiograph, choose a call and Carve, noting a carved cylinder replays without more blood

hemomancy.clinical.next.referral.about: the Alchemist telling the player to ask for A Cabinet for the Road and then take the referral to the Artificer

hemomancy.clinical.next.show_vial.about: the Alchemist telling the player to return holding one filled creature Blood Vial in either hand, after which they get the microscope lesson and recipe

hemomancy.clinical.next.storage.about: the Alchemist telling the player to craft a Phlebotomist's Cabinet themself, insert a full sample through its menu, withdraw one, and noting hoppers and Field Cases do not count toward stationary Cabinet practice

hemomancy.clinical.next.three_sources.about: the Alchemist telling the player to examine blood from three creature types with the microscope then speak to them, noting repeats of one type count once and already identified vials still need the player's own two-second examination

hemomancy.clinical.next.title.about: a player question asking the Alchemist what their next clinical assignment is
